title: A room member can get a LiveKit token to join the room's call

tasks.title: Call token endpoint for room members, with LiveKit configuration and grants
The calls switch, the room's calls field, and the API document

tasks.title: Rate limit on token requests, and secrets kept out of the log

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in member of a room calls `POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/call/token` and calls are available THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with `{ url, token, expiresAt }`, where `url` is the configured LiveKit URL and `token` is a LiveKit access token for the room `room_<roomId>` with identity `u:<sefaria user id>`, the display name from the display cache, an expiry 10 minutes after issue (equal to `expiresAt`), and metadata `{"v":1,"role":"owner"|"member"}` from `room_members`
scenarios: AC-001 AC-002 a member gets a token for this room with the member grants
AC-001 the owner's token says owner

acs.text: WHEN a token is issued to a member or owner of a room THE SYSTEM SHALL grant `roomJoin` for that room only, `canSubscribe`, `canPublish` limited to the sources microphone, camera and screen share, and `canPublishData: false`
scenarios: AC-001 AC-002 a member gets a token for this room with the member grants

acs.text: WHEN the caller is not a member of the room, or the room does not exist THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404 with the same body in both cases and issue no token
scenarios: AC-003 a non-member and a missing room look the same

acs.text: WHEN the request has no Django identity token or an invalid one THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 401 and issue no token

WHEN calls are not available (any of `LIVEKIT_URL`, `LIVEKIT_API_KEY`, `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` unset, or `CALLS_ENABLED` not `true`) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 503 with error code `call.unavailable` to the token request, and `GET /api/v1/rooms/{id}` for a member SHALL include `calls: { available: false }` (`true` when available)

WHEN one user makes more than 20 token requests for the same room within a minute THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 429 with error code `request.rate_limited` and a `retry-after` header (seconds) to the excess requests
WHEN a token request is handled, successfully or not THE SYSTEM SHALL log neither the token, nor the API key, nor the API secret, nor the caller's Django token
scenarios: AC-007 secrets never reach the log

acs.text: WHEN the OpenAPI document is generated THE SYSTEM SHALL include the token endpoint and the `calls` field, and the generated client SHALL expose them; the change is additive (api-minor)
scenarios: AC-008 the API document and client carry the endpoint
